title: Staff Software Engineer - Ingestion
description: P-375 Staff Software Engineer (L6) Location: Bangalore, India At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. The Lakeflow Connect team is building the strategic data ingestion layer for the Databricks Lakehouse, enabling seamless connectivity to enterprise applications, databases, cloud storage, and other critical data sources. This platform capability powers data and AI workflows across every surface in Databricks — from Dashboards and Notebooks to SQL and AI applications. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will work on core database internals challenges, building systems that efficiently extract data from production OLTP systems using techniques including incremental data capture and log parsing, while minimizing load on source systems. The Impact You Will Have - Design and build highly scalable, fault-tolerant data ingestion systems processing hundreds of terabytes of data daily across thousands of customers. - Own complex technical projects end-to-end, from architecture design through production deployment and operational excellence. - Drive technical strategy and influence product roadmap for critical platform capabilities used across the organization. - Perform low-level systems debugging, performance measurement, and optimization on large-scale production clusters. - Lead cross-team technical initiatives and mentor engineers to elevate team capabilities and engineering practices. What We Look For - 8+ years of software engineering experience. - Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments. - Deep understanding of database internals, including areas with technologies including replication, backup, transaction recovery, or change data capture. - Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, and their application to real-world systems challenges. - Ability to work toward multi-year technical visions with incremental, customer-impacting deliverables. - Proven track record of driving complex technical projects involving multiple teams and system boundaries. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical direction across the organization. - B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog.
